title: Understanding Polynomial Features
text: Adding polynomial features, such as degree $$3$$, increases the complexity of the model. Consider how this affects the model's ability to fit the training data and its flexibility.

title: Bias and Variance Trade-off
text: Think about how increasing model complexity with polynomial features might impact bias and variance. A more complex model can fit the training data better, but what does that mean for bias?

title: Effect on Bias
text: Does increasing the degree of polynomial features generally increase or decrease bias?

title: Effect on Variance
text: Does increasing the degree of polynomial features generally increase or decrease variance?
